Meet the founders

Two Brothers, One Family Farm

Green Cover sprouted in 2008, when brothers Keith and Brian Berns experimented with cover crops on their family farm. Still family owned and operated, Green Cover grows, cleans, mixes, and delivers cover crop seed directly to producers across the United States and Canada.
